subject: sty
title: (R)STY.------INFO.F.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 257 (PR.S(RD)II-11). STY (style) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; INFO-F (information focus) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics), SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and AFI (affinity insight). From AF-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From SOC-RT-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFI: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From INDIV-TD: ATTN (attraction). From VT-DY: POST (postulation). From SPT-DY: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics).
